# The Art of Speed Reading

Speed reading is not about skipping words. It is about presenting them so your
eyes never have to move, and your mind can keep pace with the text.

## How RSVP Works

Rapid Serial Visual Presentation flashes one word at a time in a **fixed
position**. Because your gaze stays anchored, you spend no effort tracking
across a line, and no effort jumping back to the start of the next one.

The trick that makes it comfortable is the *Optimal Recognition Point*: a pivot
letter, slightly left of centre, highlighted in a second colour. Each word is
shifted so that pivot always lands in the same column.

## Why It Feels Fast

- Your eyes stop searching for where the next word begins.
- Punctuation earns a natural pause, so sentences still breathe.
- Long, unfamiliar words get a little extra time to register.

> "The eye is a lazy muscle; give it one place to rest and it will thank you."
